name: Acid
description: Corrosive liquids, digestive enzymes, and the breath of green dragons.

name: Bludgeoning
description: Blunt force attacks — hammers, falling, constriction, and the like.

name: Cold
description: Frigid temperatures — icy blasts, the breath of white dragons, the touch of ice devils.

name: Fire
description: Red dragons' breath, common spells like fire bolt and fireball, mundane flames.

name: Force
description: Pure magical energy focused into a damaging form — magic missile, spiritual weapon.

name: Lightning
description: Lightning bolts, blue dragons' breath, and similar shocks.

name: Necrotic
description: Decay and death — wraiths, the death knight's claw, vampiric magic.

name: Piercing
description: Puncturing and impaling — arrows, bites, spears, and the like.

name: Poison
description: Venomous stings, the spittle of green dragons, lethal toxins on a blade.

name: Psychic
description: Mental abilities like the mind flayer's psionic blast or the spell mind sliver.

name: Radiant
description: Searing light — celestial creatures, the cleric's sacred flame, divine retribution.

name: Slashing
description: Cutting attacks — swords, axes, and monstrous claws.

name: Thunder
description: Concussive sound — thunderwave, shatter, the bray of a bronze dragon.
